title: Emerald View | 6BR Rental on Dune Allen Beach | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Emerald View on 30A is a 6BR Gulf front home in Dune Allen Beach with private beach access and pool. Sleeps 16. Reserve with Royal Destinations!
description_expanded: Description: Emerald View on 30A by Royal Destinations Location: Dune Allen Beach Address: 4915 W County Hwy 30A Details: Searching for the perfect Gulf front Dune Allen Beach rental for your upcoming getaway? Look no further than Emerald View on 30A. With 6-bedrooms (including the carriage house) spanning over 3 stories, large gathering spaces, an open concept layout, and an abundance of outdoor balconies overlooking the Gulf, this 30A Gulf front rental sleeps 16 and was built with family gatherings in mind. This 30A luxury rental features direct and private beach access make getting to and from the beach hassle free, a shaded private pool perfect for escaping the sun for a cool dip, and carriage house suited for multiple or extended families to make long lasting memories together. A huge plus of reserving a 30A Gulf front rental is taking in every sunrise and sunset with uninterrupted panoramic Gulf views. Located on the south side of 30A, guests of this Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental can take full advantage of peace and serenity all while being just a short walk or bike ride away from restaurants, shopping, and activities. Those looking for a 30A Gulf front rental will not be disappointed after a much-needed relaxing getaway at Emerald View on 30A! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Beachfront with Private Access -Parking Spaces: 4 in driveway -Dining Accommodations: (6) Dining Room Table, (4) at bar -Coffee Maker Available: Standard Drip and Keurig -Private Pool: 12’ x 20’ Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 16 6 Bedrooms including Carriage House / 4 Full & 1 Half Bath First Floor: -Living Room #1 with Queen Sleeper Sofa -Kitchenette with Seating for 3 at Bar -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: Bunk Room - 4 Twins -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Living Area #2 -Dining for 6 at Table, 4 at Bar -Kitchen -Bedroom 4: Full Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Half Bath Third Floor: -Bedroom 5: (Master) King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Office Area -Washer & Dryer Carriage House: -Queen Murphy Bed -Private Bath (Shower) -Full Kitchen -Bar Seating for 4 -Living Area -Washer & Dryer Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes -1 Beach Service Set* *Seasonal: March - October Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
